packet_dag.terminal_condition: The One Time provider review portal loads without showing the raw driveDropoffLinks JavaScript error and without changing provider authentication, Drive, upload, or external write behavior.

title: Provider Review Load Error Fix

reasons: Manual screenshot review found the provider review portal showing the raw error text driveDropoffLinks is not defined.
A raw JavaScript error on first paint violates the operator request that the project should load nicely.
The defect is scoped to the provider review renderer and can be fixed without auth, API, Drive, upload, or external write changes.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Drive upload folders, copy/open links, provider auth, email, WhatsApp, Stripe/payment, access grants, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, and account mutations are out of scope.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this provider review load-error fix, continue manual screenshot-reviewed packets for student portal hero readability or Operations CRM/participants layout.

operator_intent_summary: Make the Rabbi / One Time provider review portal load cleanly without a visible raw JavaScript error.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No provider auth, login, password, session, setup token, or entitlement behavior changes.
No Drive folder creation, upload, file copy, external link mutation, or provider account change.
No email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Stripe/payment, access grant, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, account mutation, publish, send, or delete.
No GHL runtime, LeadConnector reference, external CRM write, raw private evidence, or secret exposure.
No broader provider portal IA redesign, participant CRM polish, student portal polish, or Operations automation-center layout change.

known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: The provider review portal displays the raw message driveDropoffLinks is not defined above the sign-in panel.
The raw error is visible on both desktop and mobile screenshots, making the page look broken even before any login or review interaction.

expanded_phrases.loads nicely: The provider review portal should render its intended review shell or login panel without exposing JavaScript variable errors to the user.
expanded_phrases.clean: The route should avoid raw exception text and preserve the provider workspace review UI with scoped One Time branding and readable controls.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The provider review page remains a first-party One Time / BNA review portal scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider and one_time_mishnah_class.

requirements.statement: Fix the provider review route so it does not show the driveDropoffLinks variable error while rendering One Time review-mode media/dropoff panels.
requirements.expected_result: The provider review route loads on desktop and mobile without visible raw JavaScript error text or pageerror/console error, while Drive link rendering remains no-write and scoped.
acceptance_criteria: renderOneTimeProviderReview defines a safe driveDropoffLinks array before any media panel template uses renderDriveDropoffLinks.
The route /provider.html?review=one-time does not display the text driveDropoffLinks is not defined.
Local browser smoke records no pageerror/console error for the provider review route.
Full Rabbi / One Time visual audit captures provider-review screenshots without the raw error banner.
Provider auth, Drive/upload behavior, and external writes are unchanged.

criteria: Raw source and broad UI cleanup register exist for RAW-20260702-008.
